captions.detailed: A student monocular microscope with a light-gray rectangular base, a curved vertical supporting arm, and a black stage assembly. The optical head is mounted on a dual vertical guide rail system rather than a hidden track, allowing the entire head carriage to slide vertically. It features a rotating objective nosepiece with three distinct objectives (one highlighted in orange), a slide stage with a movable slide carriage, and two independent, side-mounted focus knobs (coarse and fine) that rotate continuously.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a student monocular microscope. It should feature a light-gray rectangular base, a curved back support arm, a black stage with a sliding specimen carriage, and a vertical dual-rail guide system carrying a sliding optical head with a rotating objective nosepiece. Include independent coarse and fine focus knobs on the side of the arm.
captions.factory: Construct the base and vertical support arm using Box and extruded curved geometries with a light-gray material. Build the vertical guide rails using two long, thin cylinders, and create the head carriage using a Box that slides prismatically along the vertical Z-axis. Model the rotating objective turret with a cylinder that has continuous revolute articulation, and attach three small cylinders as objectives. Create the specimen stage using a flat Box, adding a sliding carriage with a prismatic joint along the X/Y plane, and assemble two independent cylindrical focus knobs on the side of the arm with continuous rotational joints.
